headline: A saturated shelf, closed honest — the Contra ghost stage is laid to rest
lede: Every ladder rung, the flagship stage and the never-dry pick came up owned or QA-held this cycle. The lane still shipped value: a six-day-stale stage issue was verified against production and closed with live proof, and the warden's stale-arming failure mode got documented.

notes.text: #3014 (Contra attract teaches the voice orders) was a ghost — the work shipped as #3018 on Nov 23 but the twin issue stayed open. Live verification on the lane's dev server: scripted shout lands at tick 602 (~10 s), AIM UP banner paints over the jungle, the wingman obeys through the sim's own order law, the demo hands back cleanly, zero page errors. Both halves are already pinned in contracheck. Closed completed with the proof.

The never-dry arming went stale between warden tick and lane start: the named weak gap (Lemmings vent ground-drag) shipped as #3936 minutes before the session woke, and QA claimed the game itself (#3932). Rather than fabricate a POLISH against a saturated shelf, the lane posted the staleness class to #2910 with the full evidence trail.

Shelf-wide scan (93 titles, live issues) found zero unowned README gaps on any unheld title; idle-kick answers NONE at two successive tips. Emberwood's art pass merged (98e646f) and Lemmings' vents (4ef049e), so one QA hold already cleared on its own.
Already-shipped is a real ship: re-derive against origin/main before building anything, and prefer closing a ghost to duplicating someone else's merge.
